web_enabled.description: Enable the Munin web interface (HTML + graphs).

htmldir.description: Directory where Munin generates HTML and static files.

vardir.description: Directory for storing RRD databases and cache files.

logdir.description: Directory for Munin logs (node connections, errors).

graph_periods.description: Time periods (resolution levels) for which to generate graphs.

contact_addresses.description: Email addresses (comma-separated) to notify on service changes.

contact_always_send.description: Send alerts even when state hasn't changed (e.g., status reminders).

munin_master.description: Path to the Munin master process executable.

munin_html.description: Path to the Munin HTML generator script.

munin_graph.description: Path to the Munin graph generation script.

munin_logcheck.description: Path to the Munin log-checking utility.

munin_update.description: Path to the Munin data collector script.

include_dir.description: Directory containing additional configuration files to include.

nodes.description: List of monitored nodes. At least one node must be defined.

name.description: Unique identifier for this node (used in config section name and URLs).

address.description: IP address or hostname of the Munin node.

port.description: TCP port the Munin node listens on.

plugins.description: List of plugin names to enable. Empty = auto-detect plugins.

use_node_name.description: Use the node's name instead of the configured name in graphs.
